ai_show_review.summary: Hard To Handle shines in a mixed, fair‑quality Festival Express excerpt
ai_show_review.blurb: The three‑song set includes a strong Hard To Handle and decent runs of Easy Wind and Candyman. Audio fidelity is only fair, giving the performance an uneven feel despite occasional high points.
ai_show_review.review:
Recorded on July 1, 1970 at the Winnipeg Fairgrounds as part of the legendary Festival Express tour, this soundboard excerpt offers more historical curiosity than a flawless concert document. Jerry, Phil and Bob are noted for their good‑natured banter rather than any standout solos, while Pigpen’s drumming stays in the background. The highlight is an energetic Hard To Handle that captures the band’s early‑70s swagger; Easy Wind and Candyman provide solid, if unremarkable, support. Unfortunately the soundboard capture is only fair – tape hiss and uneven mixing blunt some of the group’s dynamics, making the overall listening experience feel a bit disjointed.

For Deadheads interested in the Festival Express saga, this recording is worth a spin for its novelty and the brief glimpse of Hard To Handle, but those seeking pristine audio or a consistently tight set should look elsewhere.

best_recording.reason: Only available soundboard capture; despite fair audio it contains the best representation of the set and the standout Hard To Handle performance.
